children: NetApp, Inc. reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 results with revenue of $2025M and diluted EPS of $1.88, both up strongly year over year as product demand and cloud-related offerings accelerated the business.
Revenue was $2025M, compared with $1559M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 30%.
Net income was $375M, compared with $233M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 61%.
Diluted EPS was $1.88, compared with $1.15 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 63%.
Revenue rose 30% YoY driven by a 51% increase in product sales and 15% growth in services; results were aided by an extra week in the quarter.
Product mix shifted toward all‑flash systems, representing 72% of Hybrid Cloud sales versus 64% in the prior period, increasing hardware weighting.
Demand strengthened across Public Cloud, which grew 28%, and the firm highlighted momentum in Keystone storage-as-a-service for cloud positioning.
Operational actions included price increases, diversified supplier relationships and a restructuring to refocus resources.
Company completed the DataPelago acquisition to bolster AI and analytics capabilities and expanded strategic component inventory to support execution.
